tasks.label: ТВОЯ РОЛЬ
tasks.q: Алея Діаґон гуде: чарівники з котлами, сови в клітках, вітрини з мітлами. У тебе й Гаррі однаковий список покупок до Гоґвортсу, але грошей у тебе набагато менше. Скільки чого потрібно — і чи вистачить?
tasks.q_pl: Ulica Pokątna tętni życiem: czarodzieje z kociołkami, sowy w klatkach, wystawy z miotłami. Ty i Harry macie tę samą listę zakupów do Hogwartu, ale ty masz dużo mniej pieniędzy. Ile czego trzeba — i czy wystarczy?
tasks.q_en: Diagon Alley is buzzing: wizards with cauldrons, owls in cages, shop windows full of broomsticks. You and Harry have the same Hogwarts shopping list, but you have much less money. How much of everything do you need, and will it be enough?

tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Countable: many, a few, few, too many (many people, a few Galleons). Uncountable: much, a little, little, too much (much money, a little powder). Both: a lot of, plenty of, enough. too + adj (too expensive), adj + enough (big enough), enough + noun (enough money).
tasks.q_pl: Countable: many, a few, few, too many (many people, a few Galleons). Uncountable: much, a little, little, too much (much money, a little powder). Both: a lot of, plenty of, enough. too + adj (too expensive), adj + enough (big enough), enough + noun (enough money).
tasks.q_en: Countable: many, a few, few, too many (many people, a few Galleons). Uncountable: much, a little, little, too much (much money, a little powder). Both: a lot of, plenty of, enough. too + adj (too expensive), adj + enough (big enough), enough + noun (enough money).
